# Step - length

`length` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Yields the length of each string in characters (Unicode scalar values, see the book page Type Conversion and length()).

## Forms

```text
length()
length(arg1: Scope)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").length().next()   // 5
```

## See also

- [Type Conversion](../../users_guide/type_conversion.md)
